title: Letting the day soften
summary: Before sleep, three small releases: the jaw, the story, the need to finish everything tonight.

blocks.text: You do not owe the night a summary of the day. You can arrive empty-handed.
Unclench. Widen the exhale. Let the bed hold you without you having to hold the world.

pairs.hidden: I am allowed to stop proving I deserved this rest.
